# Top-level names the game persists inside its runtime root
# (/media/fat/games/3s-arm/ on MiSTer, Paths_GetPrefPath() elsewhere).
#
# Generated by tools/mister/derive-runtime-paths.sh, which reads the source.
# `tools/mister/derive-runtime-paths.sh --check` fails if this file and the
# source disagree, and tools/mister/tests/deploy-prune-test.sh runs that check.
# Adding a new pref-path writer therefore breaks the test until the name is
# recorded here.
#
# `misterctl.sh deploy` refuses to delete anything named here (see
# mister_deploy_plan_prune in mister-common.sh). Note this is the tripwire, not
# the safety mechanism: the deploy deletes only paths a previous deploy
# recorded in its own manifest, so a name missing from this file still survives
# a deploy. That inversion is the actual fix for the twice-repeated data loss;
# this file catches the case where a package starts shipping a path the game
# also writes.
#
# One entry per line, top-level component only, `#` comments allowed.
# Every entry carries the citation that produced it.
